title: Why a user completed a purchase
description: Test the agent's ability to trace a journey from trigger through decision points to purchase.
query: Walk me through why user-001 ended up buying what they bought. What were the key decision points?

title: Common objection patterns across journeys
description: Test the agent's ability to aggregate objection data across multiple journeys.
query: What types of objections do users raise most often, and how successfully are they resolved?

title: Compare abandoned vs completed journeys
description: Test the agent's ability to identify signals that distinguish successful from unsuccessful journeys.
query: Are there any patterns that distinguish journeys that end in a purchase from those that don't?

title: How effective are recommendations
description: Test the agent's ability to evaluate recommendation acceptance rates and downstream impact.
query: How often do users accept the assistant's recommendations? Are accepted recommendations correlated with purchase completion?

title: How budget constraints shape purchases
description: Test the agent's ability to trace how budget signals influence downstream decisions.
query: How do stated budgets compare to actual spend? Do users tend to go over or under their stated budget?

title: Signals in the upgrade journey
description: Test the agent's ability to identify the mixin pattern in a complex journey with course changes.
query: What signals did user-002 give during their upgrade journey, and how did those signals change the direction of the conversation?
